title: 247. Can we be friends with our ex?

sentences.zh: 纯人工制作，品质保证。

sentences.en: I've been approaching my health really differently this year.
sentences.zh: 今年，我对待健康的方式有了很大的改变。

sentences.en: I used to be really focused on maximizing and doing more.
sentences.zh: 过去，我总是专注于追求极致和做更多的事情。

sentences.en: And now I'm just realizing that if I listen to what my body needs, I perform way better.
sentences.zh: 但现在我意识到，如果我倾听身体的需求，我的表现反而会更好。

sentences.en: And that's why I am obsessed with my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我如此痴迷于我的 WHOOP。

sentences.en: Truly, you guys, you know I'm such a data and information driven person.
sentences.zh: 说真的，大家也知道，我是一个非常依赖数据和信息的人。

sentences.en: And I love opening my WHOOP app and seeing how my sleep, my stress, my strain is correlating with my mood, with my running performance, with how I'm just feeling day to day.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢打开 WHOOP 应用程序，看看我的睡眠、压力和身体负荷如何与我的情绪、跑步表现以及我每天的感受相关联。

sentences.en: I'm not an elite athlete by any means, but I do really benefit.
sentences.zh: 我绝不是什么精英运动员，但我确实从中受益匪浅。

sentences.en: And I also just really enjoy knowing more about my body.
sentences.zh: 而且我也真的很喜欢深入了解自己的身体。

sentences.en: And WHOOP also gives me these actionable, personalized insights that have made me more intentional and meant that I make smarter decisions
sentences.zh: WHOOP 还为我提供了切实可行、个性化的见解，让我变得更有主见，也意味着我能做出更明智的决定，

sentences.en: day to day about what I need rather than just putting my foot on the gas and just going, going, going, going.
sentences.zh: 而不是每天只知道一味地踩油门，不停地向前冲。

sentences.zh: 访问 join.whoop.com/psychology 即可免费获得一个月的 WHOOP 服务。

sentences.zh: 有些人会保留他们所有的旧演出门票。

sentences.en: It brings back the music.
sentences.zh: 它能唤回音乐。

sentences.en: It brings back the memories, even the smells.
sentences.zh: 它能唤回记忆，甚至连气味都能带回来。

sentences.en: Other people collect perfume bottles or coffee mugs or overseas banknotes, classic sweaters from the 80s.
sentences.zh: 还有人收集香水瓶、咖啡杯、外国纸币，或是 80 年代的经典毛衣。

sentences.en: Collection is deeply personal.
sentences.zh: 收藏是非常私人的事情。

sentences.en: But it also says where we've come from.
sentences.zh: 但它也诉说着我们从何而来。

sentences.zh: 在全新的播客《Charmed with Sam Todd》中，

sentences.en: Sam explores the memories, obsessions, and tiny treasures that become part of who we are.
sentences.zh: Sam 探索了那些构成我们自我的记忆、执念和微小的珍宝。

sentences.en: Charmed with Sam Todd.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识萨姆·托德。

sentences.en: Stories want to tell with Pandora.
sentences.zh: 由 Pandora 呈现，讲述我们想要诉说的故事。

sentences.zh: 现在就在 iHeart 上收听该播客。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本节目。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is so great to have you here back for another episode as we, of course, break down the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 无论你是新听众还是老听众，无论你身处世界何地，很高兴你能回来收听新的一期节目，当然，我们要继续剖析 20 多岁时的心理状态。

sentences.en: It is great to have you here for a very special topic in my mind.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来，因为今天的话题在我看来非常特别。

sentences.en: Two years ago, I did an episode on whether exes could be friends.
sentences.zh: 两年前，我做过一期关于“前任能否做朋友”的节目。

sentences.en: And during that episode, I brought on my ex-boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 在那期节目中，我请来了我的前男友。

sentences.en: If you have been around for a while, you probably remember this episode.
sentences.zh: 如果你关注我有一段时间了，可能还记得那期节目。

sentences.en: And this is the first ever time that I have gone back to an episode from the archives, back to one that I recorded, you know, almost two years ago, and decided to redo it.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次回顾存档中的节目，回到我几乎两年前录制的那一期，并决定重做它。

sentences.en: Decided to basically say, you know what?
sentences.zh: 决定基本上是想说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I think that I was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我想我当时错了。

sentences.en: I don't think that what I said in that episode, the points that I made are entirely true, are mature, are actually what I believe in anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我在那期节目中所说的话、所提出的观点完全正确、成熟，也不再是我真正相信的东西了。

sentences.en: And so today, I want to redo that episode, this time without my ex-boyfriend, because we are no longer friends.
sentences.zh: 所以今天，我想重做那期节目，这次没有我的前男友，因为我们已经不再是朋友了。

sentences.en: And we haven't been friends, actually, since that episode came out.
sentences.zh: 事实上，自从那期节目播出后，我们就没再做过朋友。

sentences.en: I haven't spoken to him since that episode came out.
sentences.zh: 那期节目播出后，我就再没和他说过话。

sentences.en: And, you know, I just felt kind of strange to have this episode on the podcast, making these huge claims that it's mature to stay friends with your ex,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在播客里发表这种“和前任保持朋友关系才成熟”的宏论，让我觉得有点奇怪，

sentences.en: that it's possible, like, look at us.
sentences.zh: 觉得这似乎是可能的，你看我们不就做到了吗？

sentences.en: We've done it, when actually the reality of what happened after that was entirely to the contrary and entirely not true.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，那之后发生的事情完全相反，也完全不是那么回事。

sentences.en: That episode actually essentially meant that our friendship, or whatever it was, ended.
sentences.zh: 那期节目本质上意味着我们的友谊，或者说无论那是什么，已经结束了。

sentences.en: And I'm not going to go into specific details, but it was definitely a lesson for me around
sentences.zh: 我不会去谈论具体细节，但这对我来说绝对是一个教训，

sentences.en: the truth that people are telling you can be a different truth for other people.
sentences.zh: 关于人们告诉你的真相，对其他人来说可能是另一种真相。

sentences.en: Like, they could be telling you one thing and telling other people something different.
sentences.zh: 比如，他们可能对你是一套说辞，对别人又是另一套。

sentences.en: And it actually ended up causing me a lot of pain, like, the aftermath of that episode.
sentences.zh: 那期节目的后续影响实际上最终给我造成了很大的痛苦。

sentences.en: And, yeah, not really realizing that he hadn't been entirely honest with me.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我当时没意识到他并没有对我完全诚实。

sentences.en: There were things that he hadn't told me.
sentences.zh: 有些事情他没告诉我。

sentences.en: And to this day, it still kind of upsets me that
sentences.zh: 直到今天，我仍然感到有些难过，因为

sentences.en: I, like, kind of gave that relationship a platform when it was definitely not a perfect relationship.
sentences.zh: 我竟然为那段关系提供了一个平台，而那段关系绝对不是一段完美的关系。

sentences.en: We definitely did not have a perfect friendship.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对没有一段完美的友谊。

sentences.en: You know, I thought we were friends.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我以为我们是朋友。

sentences.en: I think he thought something differently.
sentences.zh: 我想他可能不这么认为。

sentences.en: And so it kind of came around the time to, you know, not to go into any specific reasons, but after thinking about it for a while, I was like, you know what?
sentences.zh: 所以，在思考了一段时间后，我觉得是时候了，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I think it's time that we do this again.
sentences.zh: 我想是时候重做这期节目了。

sentences.en: And it was the aftermath of that episode.
sentences.zh: 而那正是那期节目的后续影响。

sentences.en: The irony is, you know, definitely obvious to me here.
sentences.zh: 其中的讽刺意味，我在这里看得非常清楚。

sentences.en: That really proved to me that I actually don't think exes can be friends.
sentences.zh: 那件事真正向我证明了，我其实并不认为前任可以做朋友。

sentences.en: And I think that the relationship that you have with your ex ended for a reason.
sentences.zh: 我认为你和前任的关系结束是有原因的。

sentences.en: And that reason is probably just as good of a reason as to why you wouldn't want to be friends with that person anyways.
sentences.zh: 而那个原因，很可能也是你无论如何都不想和那个人做朋友的充分理由。

sentences.en: Of course, you know, there are definitely exceptions to what I'm saying.
sentences.zh: 当然，我知道我所说的肯定有例外。

sentences.en: But if you've ever seen the film, he's just not that into you.
sentences.zh: 但如果你看过电影《他其实没那么喜欢你》，

sentences.en: There is a line in that movie, a very famous line
sentences.zh: 电影里有一句非常著名的台词，

sentences.en: that typically for most of us, we are the exception.
sentences.zh: 对于我们大多数人来说，我们通常是那个例外。

sentences.en: We are not the rule.
sentences.zh: 我们不是那个规则。

sentences.en: And maybe that's why we should be.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是我们应该做的。

sentences.en: And when it comes to being friends with your ex,
sentences.zh: 当谈到和前任做朋友时，

sentences.en: I think the rule is genuinely and generally that's not a good idea.
sentences.zh: 我认为规则通常就是：这并不是个好主意。

sentences.en: And perhaps this is a hard pill for you to swallow, especially if you are just fresh out of a relationship.
sentences.zh: 也许这很难接受，尤其是如果你刚结束一段感情的话。

sentences.en: You're trying to find a way to kind of maintain a friendship because you don't want to lose them.
sentences.zh: 你试图找到一种方式来维持友谊，因为你不想失去他们。

sentences.en: You're not ready to move on.
sentences.zh: 你还没准备好继续前进。

sentences.en: I would really encourage you to keep listening, even if what we talk about in today's episode isn't necessarily what you want to hear.
sentences.zh: 我真的鼓励你继续听下去，即使今天节目里谈论的内容不一定是你想要听到的。

sentences.en: You know, in my mind, I think the friendships that we try and maintain with our exes, they all reach a breaking point sooner or later.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，我们试图与前任维持的友谊，迟早都会达到一个临界点。

sentences.en: And you can believe that you are friends.
sentences.zh: 你可以相信你们是朋友。

sentences.en: You can try and be friends.
sentences.zh: 你可以试着做朋友。

sentences.en: You can convince yourself that you are, but only up to a point.
sentences.zh: 你可以说服自己你们是朋友，但那也只能维持到一定程度。

sentences.en: And then you just kind of have to face the facts.
sentences.zh: 然后你不得不面对现实。

sentences.en: I think like any friendship, there are ups and downs.
sentences.zh: 我认为像任何友谊一样，都有起起落落。

sentences.en: But a friendship with your ex, especially someone that you once loved, that you were once romantically attracted to, sexually attracted to, there are definitely more downs than ups
sentences.zh: 但与前任的友谊，尤其是曾经相爱、曾经有过浪漫吸引力、性吸引力的人，在那种友谊中，低谷绝对比高峰多，

sentences.en: when it comes to those kinds of friendships.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到这类友谊时。

sentences.en: And it ends up impacting every other aspect of our lives, like who we go on to date, how we see ourselves, jealousy, resentment, so much more.
sentences.zh: 它最终会影响我们生活的方方面面，比如我们接下来和谁约会、我们如何看待自己、嫉妒、怨恨等等。

sentences.en: So today we are going to break down exactly why it is that my mind has been changed, what some of the research has to say about the nature of a friendship between exes
sentences.zh: 所以今天我们要详细剖析为什么我的想法改变了，研究对于前任之间友谊的本质有什么说法，

sentences.en: and why it's probably not a good idea based on principles of attraction and social psychology, but also the often deeply emotional reasons that we try and convince ourselves
sentences.zh: 以及为什么基于吸引力原则和社会心理学，这可能不是个好主意，同时也探讨那些让我们试图说服自己

sentences.en: that we can be the exception and ultimately the consequences of that.
sentences.zh: 我们可以成为例外的深层情感原因，以及最终的后果。

sentences.en: I also do want to talk about the instances where you might not have a choice.
sentences.zh: 我还想谈谈那些你可能别无选择的情况。

sentences.en: You're in the same friendship group.
sentences.zh: 你们在同一个朋友圈。

sentences.en: You co-parent, you work together, you run a business, you share assets.
sentences.zh: 你们共同抚养孩子，一起工作，经营生意，或者共享资产。

sentences.en: Whatever it is, there are situations where it's, you know, it's not up to us.
sentences.zh: 无论是什么情况，有些时候，你知道，这不由我们决定。

sentences.en: How exactly can we work through those unique circumstances the best that we can?
sentences.zh: 我们究竟该如何尽最大努力去处理这些特殊情况呢？

sentences.en: You know, since that first episode came out, so many of you have reached out to me and wanted a follow-up and they, you know, you've wanted to know whether my opinion has changed.
sentences.zh: 你知道，自从那第一期节目播出后，你们很多人联系我，想要后续报道，你们想知道我的观点是否改变了。

sentences.en: It most certainly has.
sentences.zh: 我的观点确实改变了。

sentences.en: And I've definitely also become more informed both through experience and also just a deeper look at what's factual and what's evidence-based.
sentences.zh: 而且通过经验，以及对事实和证据的深入研究，我肯定也变得更了解情况了。

sentences.en: So hopefully I can bestow some of that wisdom onto you.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望我能把其中的一些智慧传授给你们。

sentences.en: Without further ado, let's get into the nitty-gritty of maintaining a friendship with your ex and why that's probably not always going to be a good idea.
sentences.zh: 废话不多说，让我们深入探讨维持与前任友谊的细节，以及为什么这通常不是个好主意。

sentences.en: I feel as if a lot of us end a relationship with this hope that we can stay friends.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们很多人结束一段关系时，都怀着一种希望，那就是我们还能做朋友。

sentences.en: You know, it's almost a bit of a cliche that you hear a lot.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这几乎成了一句陈词滥调，你经常听到。

sentences.en: You know, yeah, we broke up, but we're going to stay friends.
sentences.zh: 你知道，是的，我们分手了，但我们会保持朋友关系。

sentences.en: We're going to try and stay friends.
sentences.zh: 我们会试着保持朋友关系。

sentences.en: Who amongst that hasn't said that before?
sentences.zh: 谁没说过这种话呢？

sentences.en: And I'm obviously included, very much included in that boat.
sentences.zh: 显然我也包括在内，非常包括在内。

sentences.en: We have this real sense that we can kind of keep things friendly and still, you know, remain in each other's lives.
sentences.zh: 我们有一种真实的感觉，认为我们可以保持友好，并且，你知道，仍然留在彼此的生活中。

sentences.en: Despite all of those who have tried before us,
sentences.zh: 尽管有那么多人在我们之前尝试过，

sentences.en: we can be the exception.
sentences.zh: 我们依然觉得自己可以成为那个例外。

sentences.en: And I think primarily the reason we think that is because the idea of going from a relationship to a friendship is a lot easier to digest than going from a relationship to nothing.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们之所以这样想，主要是因为从一段关系转变为友谊，比从一段关系变为彻底断绝更容易让人接受。

sentences.en: That leap into the abyss just kind of feels way too mentally painful for us to grasp onto in the midst of a lot of other feelings.
sentences.zh: 那种跳入深渊的感觉，在各种情绪交织的情况下，对我们来说太痛苦了，难以承受。

sentences.en: The notion, you know, that this person could suddenly not be in our lives anymore when they were probably one of the most important people to us only a few hours, a few days,
sentences.zh: 那种想法，你知道，这个人可能突然就不再出现在我们的生活中了，而就在几个小时、几天、

sentences.en: a few weeks ago, that is really, really horrifying.
sentences.zh: 几周前，他们可能还是对我们最重要的人之一，这真的非常非常可怕。

sentences.en: It's a big adjustment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的调整。

sentences.en: Of course, you know, if an ex cheated, if something horrific happened, if there was like an all-out explosion, it's a lot easier to make that call and to just be like,
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道，如果前任出轨了，如果发生了什么可怕的事情，如果发生了彻底的爆发，那么做出那个决定就容易多了，你会觉得：

sentences.en: I never want to see that person again because their true colors, you know, are very, very real in that moment.
sentences.zh: 我再也不想见到那个人了，因为在那一刻，他们的真面目，你知道，是非常非常真实的。

sentences.en: There is no forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 没有原谅。

sentences.en: There is no moving on.
sentences.zh: 没有继续前进。

sentences.en: But in those relationships where nothing drastic has happened, you know, it's more of a slow realization.
sentences.zh: 但在那些没有发生什么剧烈变故的关系中，你知道，这更像是一种缓慢的觉醒。

sentences.en: That's where you get into trouble.
sentences.zh: 那就是你陷入麻烦的时候。

sentences.en: The kind of breakups that I think best lend us to believing that we can stay friends with our exes are firstly, those in which we were friends to begin with.
sentences.zh: 我认为最容易让我们相信可以和前任做朋友的那种分手，首先是那些本来就是朋友的关系。

sentences.en: You know, if you were, if you initially had that foundation of platonic intimacy, I think moving into a romantic space and then having to exit it
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你最初有那种柏拉图式的亲密基础，我认为进入浪漫空间然后不得不退出，

sentences.en: and maybe losing that friendship as well, it's just such a loss.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能连那份友谊也失去了，这真是一种巨大的损失。

sentences.en: However, I do think that once you have a romantic relationship with someone, the very core, the very nature of that relationship has been changed.
sentences.zh: 然而，我确实认为，一旦你和某人有了浪漫关系，那段关系的本质就已经改变了。

sentences.en: It's a different dynamic now.
sentences.zh: 现在是另一种动态了。

sentences.en: It's never going to be the same and that's something that we all kind of have to, you know, accept or expect when we first start dating a friend.
sentences.zh: 它永远不会和以前一样了，这是我们刚开始和朋友约会时就应该接受或预料到的。

sentences.en: Once you move into that territory, I think it's very hard to exit it in a way that is not painful and in which no one's going to be hurt.
sentences.zh: 一旦你进入那个领域，我认为很难以一种不痛苦、不伤害任何人的方式退出。

sentences.en: Another example, I think, of the kinds of relationships where we really think we can stay friends with someone is when the relationship has just fizzled.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们真的认为可以和某人保持朋友关系的另一种情况是，当这段关系只是逐渐平淡时。

sentences.en: I often think that, you know, when it's just kind of like, oh, I don't really have feelings for you anymore.
sentences.zh: 我经常想，你知道，当感觉就像是，哦，我真的对你没感觉了。

sentences.en: Yeah, me neither.
sentences.zh: 是的，我也是。

sentences.en: You're kind of like, okay, well, maybe we're better off as friends.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得，好吧，也许我们做朋友更好。

sentences.en: But suddenly, and I see this a lot, in the aftermath, this person is like more exciting to you.
sentences.zh: 但突然间，我经常看到这种情况，在分手后，这个人对你来说反而更令人兴奋了。

sentences.en: You know, while you're in a relationship with them, you didn't have feelings for them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你在和他们交往时，你对他们没感觉。

sentences.en: Things were fading, but then suddenly
sentences.zh: 感情正在消退，但突然间

sentences.en: they're off limits.
sentences.zh: 他们成了禁区。

sentences.en: Suddenly, it's exciting.
sentences.zh: 突然间，这变得令人兴奋了。

sentences.en: It's known in psychology as reactance theory.
